transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for making time to discuss the extended library hours pilot. As I understand it, we're here to go through the pre-authorization review for the eight-week pilot that would keep the main library open Monday through Friday from 10:00 p.m. to midnight, with one library employee on duty and standard student-ID access. Before I can sign off on the operating plan, I need to hear from each of the reviewing offices — facilities, campus safety, library IT, and finance — about any requirements or concerns you have. Let's work through each office in turn so we can finalize the plan. Who would like to start?

transcript.text: Before we go further, I need to raise a campus safety requirement. Our policy requires at least two authorized adults in the building whenever the library remains open after 10:00 p.m. I confirmed this with the evening patrol supervisor this week, but I have not yet added it to the operating plan. As the proposal currently stands, it lists only one library employee on duty, which would not meet this requirement. We'll need to adjust the staffing plan to include a second authorized adult for the late-night hours.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to raise a library IT requirement before we finalize this plan. During a recent system check, I identified a configuration issue with our access-control system: it can support the pilot only if entry is limited to currently enrolled students using college ID cards. If we allow unrestricted access for all standard ID holders after 10:00 p.m., expired and visitor credentials would remain active during those late hours. I have not yet reported this to the director, but the operating plan will need to specify that late-night access is restricted to currently enrolled students with valid college ID cards.

transcript.text: Thank you all for raising these important points. Let me summarize what I'm hearing so we can work toward a finalized plan. Jamal, the Wednesday fire-alarm tests mean the library cannot be open on Wednesdays during the pilot — so we'd be looking at Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday evenings instead of all five weekdays. Captain Ruiz, campus safety requires two authorized adults on site after 10 p.m., so we'll need to adjust the staffing plan accordingly. Priya, library IT needs the operating plan to specify that late-night access is restricted to currently enrolled students with valid college ID cards only — not unrestricted standard ID access. And Marcus, the library innovation grant provides $3,200 for evening-pilot overtime and explicitly permits two-person coverage, which addresses the funding for Captain Ruiz's requirement. Before I finalize and sign the operating plan, I want to make sure everyone is satisfied that these adjustments address their concerns. Are there any additional requirements from any office, or are we ready to settle on: Monday/Tuesday/Thursday/Friday from 10 p.m. to midnight, two authorized adults on site, access limited to currently enrolled students with valid college ID, funded by the library innovation grant at $3,200?
